title: Mixed Event — Wonderhorror?! A Test of Courage! — Episode2 Getting Into the Weeds

meta.Event Outline: Class representatives Emu and Mafuyu are assigned to run a voluntary weeding activity. But no one's signing up to pull weeds in the blazing summer heat! Emu thinks of a way to make it fun for the participants.

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Vacant Classroom

rows.Speaker: Class President
rows.Line: Alright, let's begin the meeting.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Class President
rows.Line: Today, we'll be discussing the volunteer work we do each year.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Volunteer work...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. This is going to be your first time, Otori.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Each year, the class representatives assist with local volunteer programs.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Last year, we picked up trash around the city, raised money for charity and helped out at the children's center.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Really?!
That sounds like fun!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. It actually is very rewarding.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: In particular, because the class representatives are essentially in charge of operations. We'll be recruiting other volunteers and coming up with detailed plans for how each program is run.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
What?!
We're in charge of operations?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That's right. Some teachers will also be there, but in general, we have to take the lead.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Are you interested in running something like this, Otori?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yes! I wanna learn all I can about running these kinds of events in order to make my dream come true!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I see. Then, this should be a good opportunity for you.

rows.Speaker: Class President
rows.Line: Alright, as always, we'll be drawing program names from a box to see who is going to be in charge of what.

rows.Speaker: Class President
rows.Line: Each volunteer program will have two students assigned to it. After we draw names, you'll all break off into your pairs to discuss the details of your activities.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Hehe. I can't wait to see where I get to volunteer.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Making the city sparkling clean by picking up trash would put smiles on the faces of everyone who comes to visit...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Raising money for charity would also help make lots and lots of people smile!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (And playing with kids at the children center would be so wonderhoy! No matter what I'm asked to do, I'm gonna do my absolute best!)

rows.Speaker: Class President
rows.Line: Next, Otori. Please draw a name for us.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Okay! Hmm...
This one!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Let's see... Oh!
I'll be pulling weeds!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, that means you're with me.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
What?!
You got the same one, Asahina?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Woohoo!
Let's pull lots and lots of weeds together!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. I have a feeling that doing this activity with you is going to be very fun.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: So, let's do our best.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: O-Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (No, she's smiling but not again...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Wait, actually...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Us working together means I have a chance to make her really smile!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Which means I'll need to pull lots and lots of weeds and make Operation: Smiley Face a success!)

rows.Speaker: Class President
rows.Line: Alright, please break off into your pairs to discuss your various activities.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay, why don't we take a look at what we'll actually be doing first?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: According to this printout, we'll be pulling weeds in the area highlighted on this map.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That includes this shrine's grounds and the surrounding neighborhood.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Also, the neighborhood association has already set the date, but the time of day seems to be up to us.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Which means we'll need to come up with a schedule and figure out how many volunteers we'll need. There's also...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(Asahina's really organized...!
She's so cool!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Alright, I've gotta do my best too!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, we also need to figure out what the volunteers should bring on the day of, as well as what equipment we'll need!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes, we do.
People volunteer for this every year, from what I understand, so we should probably look at last year's records.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay, this list should include all the equipment we need.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We also decided when and where to meet!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Then, that leaves...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Figuring out how we're actually going to recruit volunteers...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? How we're going to recruit them?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes. Since we're being asked to cover quite a large area, I think we're going to need around thirty people...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But students at our school are usually busy with their clubs or studying for exams this time of year. Not to mention that people are unlikely to want to pull weeds in the summer heat. We'll obviously take measures to prevent anyone from getting heatstroke, but even still...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh... Right...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then, we gotta recruit them in a way that'll get them to want to pull weeds with us!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Get them to want to pull weeds with us?
That isn't going to be easy...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We can start by putting up posters and handing out flyers... But we'll probably need to come up with more effective ideas...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmmmmmm...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh!
What if we put on a show?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: If we do a show about how fun it is to pull weeds, then others might decide to sign up!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
A show...
Yes, that is one way to advertise this event...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But we'd need to write the script, recruit a cast, secure equipment, make props and find a place to perform. I'm not sure we have the time to do all that...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, right...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Then, I know!
What if the two of us held a parade?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: A parade?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yes! I could bang a big drum really loudly while you play a recorder!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And we'd shout, “Pulling weeds with everyone is so much fun!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: No, wait...! Making a bunch of noise in a quiet neighborhood is probably a really bad idea...! Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. Let's try brainstorming a little longer.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hmm...!
Then, what if we...?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh...
It's already time to go home.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
What?!
No, we still haven't come up with a good idea yet!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But you did come up with quite a lot, Otori. I really appreciate your creativity. I tried, but I couldn't think of anything promising either...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But we still have plenty of time, so let's do our best to keep coming up with ideas.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We can begin by making posters and flyers like we initially discussed.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, I can make those!
I really love to draw!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Okay.
Then, if you don't mind...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: And if those don't work, we'll try another method.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Roger dodger!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Alright...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I've gotta make a poster that's gonna make everyone want to pull weeds with us!)
